# openwrt_service (Resource)

Controls an init script in /etc/init.d (enable at boot, keep running, restart on change). Destroying the resource leaves the service as it is.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Init script name, e.g. `dnsmasq`.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Start at boot. Unset leaves it alone.
- `restart_triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values; any change restarts the service.
- `running` (Boolean) Keep the service running (true) or stopped (false). Unset leaves it alone.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
